problem.title: Revenue leaks quietly, one claim at a time.

cards.title: Rising denials
cards.blurb: Three in five medical groups report denial rates rising year over year.

cards.title: Aged AR nobody works
cards.blurb: Claims sit past 120 days until they time out. By then Medicare's first-level appeal window has closed too.

cards.title: No revenue visibility
cards.blurb: You learn about a collection problem weeks late, because checking where one claim stands is still the most time-consuming task in the revenue cycle.

cards.title: Providers not enrolled
cards.blurb: New hires see patients before payers will pay for them. Effective dates are not backdated.
cards.source: BCBS of Texas · Ohio Rev. Code 3963.06 · La. R.S. 22:1009
